{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Calculate the fraction of enrolled patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = data[data['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]
total_count = data.shape[0]
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_count

# Print the result
print(f'Severe count: {severe_count}')
print(f'Total count: {total_count}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')"}
